This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Tampines GreenQuartz renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Tampines GreenQuartz interior
sections.text:
Tampines is a mature, well-equipped new town, and owners who are close to keys usually plan the first fit-out as a long stay: school bags at the door, a kitchen that can take family cooking, and bedrooms with proper wardrobes. The joinery that typically does that job is a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry or fridge run, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall. Maison specifies this as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will design from your approved plan only. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed.

Rivelle Tampines, packed earlier, is an executive condominium page in District 18 and is a nearby link for readers in the same town, not a typologies or key-date reference for GreenQuartz. We will not invent walking times to Tampines town, to a park, or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
